description: This file defines the Review model class for the admin catalog in an OpenCart project. It provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving review records from the database, as well as updating product ratings and review statuses.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Defines the Review model class with methods for managing product reviews in the OpenCart admin catalog.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Creates a new review record in the database and updates the product rating accordingly.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Edits an existing review record identified by review_id, updates the database, and recalculates the product rating.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a review record (approved or not).

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a review record and updates the associated product's rating.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all reviews associated with a specific product ID.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific review by review ID.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating for a specific product based on approved reviews.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews based on various filters such as product name, author, status, and date range.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Returns the total count of reviews matching given filters.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Returns the total number of reviews pending approval.
